sanskrit: soma̍sya mā ta̱vasa̱ṁ vakṣy a̍gne̱ vahni̍ṁ cakartha vi̱dathe̱ yaja̍dhyai | de̱vām̐ acchā̱ dīdya̍d yu̱ñje adri̍ṁ śamā̱ye a̍gne ta̱nva̍ṁ juṣasva ||
english: O Agni, Soma's mighty one, you bear me — you have been made the conveyor at the sacrifice for worship. Shining toward the gods you harness the pressing-stone; for peace, O Agni, be pleased with your own body.

sanskrit: prāñca̍ṁ ya̱jñaṁ ca̍kṛma̱ vardha̍tā̱ṁ gīḥ sa̱midbhi̍r a̱gniṁ nama̍sā duvasyan | di̱vaḥ śa̍śāsur vi̱dathā̍ kavī̱nāṁ gṛtsā̍ya cit ta̱vase̍ gā̱tum ī̍ṣuḥ ||
english: We have directed the sacrifice eastward; let our song increase while we honour Agni with fuel and reverence. The wise ones who have ruled the assemblies of heaven have sought a path even to the mighty one for the Gṛtsamadas.

sanskrit: mayo̍ dadhe̱ medhi̍raḥ pū̱tada̍kṣo di̱vaḥ su̱bandhu̍r ja̱nuṣā̍ pṛthi̱vyāḥ | avi̍ndann u darśa̱tam a̱psv a1̱̍ntar de̱vāso̍ a̱gnim a̱pasi̱ svasṝ̍ṇām ||
english: The wise one of pure skill, kinsman of heaven by birth and of earth, has established the seat of joy. The gods found Agni, the visible one, dwelling within the waters, amid the work of the sister-streams.

sanskrit: ava̍rdhayan su̱bhaga̍ṁ sa̱pta ya̱hvīḥ śve̱taṁ ja̍jñā̱nam a̍ru̱ṣam ma̍hi̱tvā | śiśu̱ṁ na jā̱tam a̱bhy ā̍ru̱r aśvā̍ de̱vāso̍ a̱gniṁ jani̍man vapuṣyan ||
english: The seven great rivers nurtured the blessed one, born white and ruddy in his greatness. The divine mares ran around Agni at his birth, as though around a new-born child, glorying in his beauty.

sanskrit: śu̱krebhi̱r aṅgai̱ raja̍ ātata̱nvān kratu̍m punā̱naḥ ka̱vibhi̍ḥ pa̱vitrai̍ḥ | śo̱cir vasā̍na̱ḥ pary āyu̍r a̱pāṁ śriyo̍ mimīte bṛha̱tīr anū̍nāḥ ||
english: Spreading his domain with bright limbs, purifying wisdom with the strainers of the seers, clothing himself in flame, measuring out the life-span of the waters — he fashions their great splendours, full and unfailing.

sanskrit: va̱vrājā̍ sī̱m ana̍datī̱r ada̍bdhā di̱vo ya̱hvīr ava̍sānā̱ ana̍gnāḥ | sanā̱ atra̍ yuva̱taya̱ḥ sayo̍nī̱r eka̱ṁ garbha̍ṁ dadhire sa̱pta vāṇī̍ḥ ||
english: The mighty ones of heaven, inviolate and fireless, have wandered about not crying out, coming to rest. Here the seven voices, ever young and of one womb, have held together the single embryo.

sanskrit: stī̱rṇā a̍sya sa̱ṁhato̍ vi̱śvarū̍pā ghṛ̱tasya̱ yonau̍ sra̱vathe̱ madhū̍nām | asthu̱r atra̍ dhe̱nava̱ḥ pinva̍mānā ma̱hī da̱smasya̍ mā̱tarā̍ samī̱cī ||
english: His forms, all gathered together and all-shaped, are spread in the womb of ghee at the flowing of the sweet liquors. There the swelling cows have stood; the two great mothers of the wondrous one have met together.

sanskrit: ba̱bhrā̱ṇaḥ sū̍no sahaso̱ vy a̍dyau̱d dadhā̍naḥ śu̱krā ra̍bha̱sā vapū̍ṁṣi | ścota̍nti̱ dhārā̱ madhu̍no ghṛ̱tasya̱ vṛṣā̱ yatra̍ vāvṛ̱dhe kāvye̍na ||
english: Shining brown, the son of strength has blazed forth, bearing bright and vigorous forms. The streams of honey and of ghee drip down where the bull has grown through his poetic power.

sanskrit: pi̱tuś ci̱d ūdha̍r ja̱nuṣā̍ viveda̱ vy a̍sya̱ dhārā̍ asṛja̱d vi dhenā̍ḥ | guhā̱ cara̍nta̱ṁ sakhi̍bhiḥ śi̱vebhi̍r di̱vo ya̱hvībhi̱r na guhā̍ babhūva ||
english: By his birth he found even the udder of the father; he poured forth his streams and loosed the milk-cows. Moving in secret with his benevolent companions, through the great powers of heaven, he was no longer hidden in the cave.

sanskrit: pi̱tuś ca̱ garbha̍ṁ jani̱tuś ca̍ babhre pū̱rvīr eko̍ adhaya̱t pīpyā̍nāḥ | vṛṣṇe̍ sa̱patnī̱ śuca̍ye̱ saba̍ndhū u̱bhe a̍smai manu̱ṣye̱3̱̍ ni pā̍hi ||
english: He bore the embryo of both father and mother; alone he sucked the many swelling ones. The two co-wives of the gleaming bull, kindred to each other, both human — protect them for him.

sanskrit: u̱rau ma̱hām̐ a̍nibā̱dhe va̍va̱rdhāpo̍ a̱gniṁ ya̱śasa̱ḥ saṁ hi pū̱rvīḥ | ṛ̱tasya̱ yonā̍v aśaya̱d damū̍nā jāmī̱nām a̱gnir a̱pasi̱ svasṝ̍ṇām ||
english: In wide space the great one, unimpeded, has grown, for many glorious waters have come together in Agni. The householder has lain in the womb of Ṛta; Agni rests in the work of the kindred sister-streams.

sanskrit: a̱kro na ba̱bhriḥ sa̍mi̱the ma̱hīnā̍ṁ didṛ̱kṣeya̍ḥ sū̱nave̱ bhāṛ̍jīkaḥ | ud u̱sriyā̱ jani̍tā̱ yo ja̱jānā̱pāṁ garbho̱ nṛta̍mo ya̱hvo a̱gniḥ ||
english: Brown like a hawk in the encounter of the great ones, brilliant Agni, wishing to be seen, comes to his son. He who begot the ruddy cows — the great young Agni, embryo of the waters, most manly — has risen up.

sanskrit: a̱pāṁ garbha̍ṁ darśa̱tam oṣa̍dhīnā̱ṁ vanā̍ jajāna su̱bhagā̱ virū̍pam | de̱vāsa̍ś ci̱n mana̍sā̱ saṁ hi ja̱gmuḥ pani̍ṣṭhaṁ jā̱taṁ ta̱vasa̍ṁ duvasyan ||
english: The auspicious one has engendered the visible embryo of the waters and the forests and the herbs, of manifold forms. Even the gods came together in mind to honour the most admirable one, the mighty one just born.

sanskrit: bṛ̱hanta̱ id bhā̱navo̱ bhāṛ̍jīkam a̱gniṁ sa̍canta vi̱dyuto̱ na śu̱krāḥ | guhe̍va vṛ̱ddhaṁ sada̍si̱ sve a̱ntar a̍pā̱ra ū̱rve a̱mṛta̱ṁ duhā̍nāḥ ||
english: Great are the bright rays that follow brilliant Agni like lightnings; grown large as if in a cave, within his own seat, in the wide, unbounded expanse they milk for him the immortal draught.

sanskrit: īḻe̍ ca tvā̱ yaja̍māno ha̱virbhi̱r īḻe̍ sakhi̱tvaṁ su̍ma̱tiṁ nikā̍maḥ | de̱vair avo̍ mimīhi̱ saṁ ja̍ri̱tre rakṣā̍ ca no̱ damye̍bhi̱r anī̍kaiḥ ||
english: The sacrificer praises you with oblations and eagerly praises your friendship and your favour. Grant protection to the singer together with the gods, and guard us with your domestic forces.

sanskrit: u̱pa̱kṣe̱tāra̱s tava̍ supraṇī̱te 'gne̱ viśvā̍ni̱ dhanyā̱ dadhā̍nāḥ | su̱reta̍sā̱ śrava̍sā̱ tuñja̍mānā a̱bhi ṣyā̍ma pṛtanā̱yūm̐r ade̍vān ||
english: O Agni of excellent guidance, may those who dwell near you, holding all wealth, impelling with good seed and fame, may we prevail over the godless ones who make war.

sanskrit: ā de̱vānā̍m abhavaḥ ke̱tur a̍gne ma̱ndro viśvā̍ni̱ kāvyā̍ni vi̱dvān | prati̱ martā̍m̐ avāsayo̱ damū̍nā̱ anu̍ de̱vān ra̍thi̱ro yā̍si̱ sādha̍n ||
english: O Agni, knowing all poetic wisdom, you have become the brilliant beacon of the gods. As the householder you have set men to face the task; you go as the charioteer after the gods, accomplishing your aim.

sanskrit: ni du̍ro̱ṇe a̱mṛto̱ martyā̍nā̱ṁ rājā̍ sasāda vi̱dathā̍ni̱ sādha̍n | ghṛ̱tapra̍tīka urvi̱yā vy a̍dyaud a̱gnir viśvā̍ni̱ kāvyā̍ni vi̱dvān ||
english: The immortal has sat down as king in the dwelling of mortals, accomplishing the affairs of the assembly. With face glistening with ghee, Agni has shone out broadly, knowing all things worthy of the sage.

sanskrit: ā no̍ gahi sa̱khyebhi̍ḥ śi̱vebhi̍r ma̱hān ma̱hībhi̍r ū̱tibhi̍ḥ sara̱ṇyan | a̱sme ra̱yim ba̍hu̱laṁ saṁta̍rutraṁ su̱vāca̍m bhā̱gaṁ ya̱śasa̍ṁ kṛdhī naḥ ||
english: Come to us, great one, swift-moving with your benevolent friendships, with your great aids. Grant us abundant and ample wealth, a share of fair speech and renown.

sanskrit: e̱tā te̍ agne̱ jani̍mā̱ sanā̍ni̱ pra pū̱rvyāya̱ nūta̍nāni vocam | ma̱hānti̱ vṛṣṇe̱ sava̍nā kṛ̱temā janma̍ñ-janma̱n nihi̍to jā̱tave̍dāḥ ||
english: These, O Agni, are your ancient births; I have proclaimed new ones for the primordial. Great pressings have been set in motion for the bull; birth after birth the Knower-of-all-births has been established.

sanskrit: janma̍ñ-janma̱n nihi̍to jā̱tave̍dā vi̱śvāmi̍trebhir idhyate̱ aja̍sraḥ | tasya̍ va̱yaṁ su̍ma̱tau ya̱jñiya̱syāpi̍ bha̱dre sau̍mana̱se syā̍ma ||
english: Birth after birth the Knower-of-all-births is established; he is kindled unceasing by the Viśvāmitras. May we be in the auspicious favour and fair benevolence of that god worthy of worship.

sanskrit: i̱maṁ ya̱jñaṁ sa̍hasāva̱n tvaṁ no̍ deva̱trā dhe̍hi sukrato̱ rarā̍ṇaḥ | pra ya̍ṁsi hotar bṛha̱tīr iṣo̱ no 'gne̱ mahi̱ dravi̍ṇa̱m ā ya̍jasva ||
english: O mighty one, place this our sacrifice among the gods, O Agni of good resolve, bestowing gifts. Do you send forth our great nourishments, O Hotar; O Agni, win great wealth for us by sacrifice.

sanskrit: iḻā̍m agne puru̱daṁsa̍ṁ sa̱niṁ goḥ śa̍śvatta̱maṁ hava̍mānāya sādha | syān na̍ḥ sū̱nus tana̍yo vi̱jāvāgne̱ sā te̍ suma̱tir bhū̍tv a̱sme ||
english: O Agni, accomplish for the worshipper Iḷā of many wonders, the ever-abiding winning of the cow. May there be for us a son and offspring rich in descendants; O Agni, may that favour of yours be upon us.

sanskrit: vai̱śvā̱na̱rāya̍ dhi̱ṣaṇā̍m ṛtā̱vṛdhe̍ ghṛ̱taṁ na pū̱tam a̱gnaye̍ janāmasi | dvi̱tā hotā̍ra̱m manu̍ṣaś ca vā̱ghato̍ dhi̱yā ratha̱ṁ na kuli̍śa̱ḥ sam ṛ̍ṇvati ||
english: For Vaiśvānara who augments the Truth, for Agni, we proclaim wisdom like clarified butter; the axe fashions both the Hotar of man and the praising singer, as a chariot is built with insight.

sanskrit: sa ro̍cayaj ja̱nuṣā̱ roda̍sī u̱bhe sa mā̱tror a̍bhavat pu̱tra īḍya̍ḥ | ha̱vya̱vāḻ a̱gnir a̱jara̱ś cano̍hito dū̱ḻabho̍ vi̱śām ati̍thir vi̱bhāva̍suḥ ||
english: By his birth he illumined both world-halves; he became the praiseworthy son of his two mothers. Agni, the carrier of oblations, unaging, delightful in food, hard to deceive, guest of the peoples, rich in light.

sanskrit: kratvā̱ dakṣa̍sya̱ taru̍ṣo̱ vidha̍rmaṇi de̱vāso̍ a̱gniṁ ja̍nayanta̱ citti̍bhiḥ | ru̱ru̱cā̱nam bhā̱nunā̱ jyoti̍ṣā ma̱hām atya̱ṁ na vāja̍ṁ sani̱ṣyann upa̍ bruve ||
english: By the will and skill of the prevailing one, in the ordering of things, the gods engendered Agni with their thoughts. I invoke the great, shining one with radiance and light, as one who is about to win a prize like a swift horse.

sanskrit: ā ma̱ndrasya̍ sani̱ṣyanto̱ vare̍ṇyaṁ vṛṇī̱mahe̱ ahra̍ya̱ṁ vāja̍m ṛ̱gmiya̍m | rā̱tim bhṛgū̍ṇām u̱śija̍ṁ ka̱vikra̍tum a̱gniṁ rāja̍ntaṁ di̱vyena̍ śo̱ciṣā̍ ||
english: Wishing to win, we choose the chosen, the excellent prize of the joyful one, the boldly-won, song-worthy; the gift of the Bhṛgus, the zealous one, of poet's wisdom, Agni shining with his heavenly flame.

sanskrit: a̱gniṁ su̱mnāya̍ dadhire pu̱ro janā̱ vāja̍śravasam i̱ha vṛ̱ktaba̍rhiṣaḥ | ya̱tasru̍caḥ su̱ruca̍ṁ vi̱śvade̍vyaṁ ru̱draṁ ya̱jñānā̱ṁ sādha̍diṣṭim a̱pasā̍m ||
english: The peoples here have set Agni in the fore for their well-being, the winner of prizes and fame, they who have strewn the sacred grass; with ladles stretched out they place the brilliantly gleaming, all-divine, Rudra-like Agni, the fulfiller of sacrificial purpose and of works.

sanskrit: pāva̍kaśoce̱ tava̱ hi kṣaya̱m pari̱ hota̍r ya̱jñeṣu̍ vṛ̱ktaba̍rhiṣo̱ nara̍ḥ | agne̱ duva̍ i̱cchamā̍nāsa̱ āpya̱m upā̍sate̱ dravi̍ṇaṁ dhehi̱ tebhya̍ḥ ||
english: O Hotar of pure flame, the men who have strewn the sacred grass at sacrifices move around your dwelling. O Agni, those who seek your service attend to that which they may obtain; bestow wealth upon them.

sanskrit: ā roda̍sī apṛṇa̱d ā sva̍r ma̱haj jā̱taṁ yad e̍nam a̱paso̱ adhā̍rayan | so a̍dhva̱rāya̱ pari̍ ṇīyate ka̱vir atyo̱ na vāja̍sātaye̱ cano̍hitaḥ ||
english: When the working waters supported him at his birth, he filled both world-halves and the great sun. That seer, delightful in food, is led about for the sacrifice like a swift horse intent on winning the prize.

sanskrit: na̱ma̱syata̍ ha̱vyadā̍tiṁ svadhva̱raṁ du̍va̱syata̱ damya̍ṁ jā̱tave̍dasam | ra̱thīr ṛ̱tasya̍ bṛha̱to vica̍rṣaṇir a̱gnir de̱vānā̍m abhavat pu̱rohi̍taḥ ||
english: Honour the giver of oblations and performer of sacrifice; serve the Knower-of-all-births who dwells in the house. The charioteer of great Ṛta, all-pervading, Agni has become the Purohita of the gods.

sanskrit: ti̱sro ya̱hvasya̍ sa̱midha̱ḥ pari̍jmano̱ 'gner a̍punann u̱śijo̱ amṛ̍tyavaḥ | tāsā̱m ekā̱m ada̍dhu̱r martye̱ bhuja̍m u lo̱kam u̱ dve upa̍ jā̱mim ī̍yatuḥ ||
english: The zealous, immortal ones have purified the three fuel-loads of the wide-ranging great Agni. Of these three, they gave one for the enjoyment of mortals; the other two have gone to their kindred abode.

sanskrit: vi̱śāṁ ka̱viṁ vi̱śpati̱m mānu̍ṣī̱r iṣa̱ḥ saṁ sī̍m akṛṇva̱n svadhi̍ti̱ṁ na teja̍se | sa u̱dvato̍ ni̱vato̍ yāti̱ vevi̍ṣa̱t sa garbha̍m e̱ṣu bhuva̍neṣu dīdharat ||
english: The human refreshments made the seer and lord of the clans into a hatchet-like sharpness for their aim. He goes flickering up hills and into valleys; he has maintained the embryo in these worlds.

sanskrit: sa ji̍nvate ja̱ṭhare̍ṣu prajajñi̱vān vṛṣā̍ ci̱treṣu̱ nāna̍da̱n na si̱ṁhaḥ | vai̱śvā̱na̱raḥ pṛ̍thu̱pājā̱ ama̍rtyo̱ vasu̱ ratnā̱ daya̍māno̱ vi dā̱śuṣe̍ ||
english: Born knowing, he pleases those in whose bellies he dwells; the bull-like one roars magnificently like a lion. Vaiśvānara of wide radiance, immortal, distributes goods and precious things to the worshipper.

sanskrit: vai̱śvā̱na̱raḥ pra̱tnathā̱ nāka̱m āru̍had di̱vas pṛ̱ṣṭham bhanda̍mānaḥ su̱manma̍bhiḥ | sa pū̍rva̱vaj ja̱naya̍ñ ja̱ntave̱ dhana̍ṁ samā̱nam ajma̱m pary e̍ti̱ jāgṛ̍viḥ ||
english: Vaiśvānara has ascended to the vault of heaven, to the back of the sky, rejoicing with holy praises. Wakeful, like the sun of old, generating wealth for the creature, he traverses the same course.

sanskrit: ṛ̱tāvā̍naṁ ya̱jñiya̱ṁ vipra̍m u̱kthya1̱̍m ā yaṁ da̱dhe mā̍ta̱riśvā̍ di̱vi kṣaya̍m | taṁ ci̱trayā̍ma̱ṁ hari̍keśam īmahe sudī̱tim a̱gniṁ su̍vi̱tāya̱ navya̍se ||
english: We implore the law-abiding, sacrificeable, inspired, worthy-of-praise one, whom Mātariśvan established with his celestial dwelling — the radiant Agni of golden hair, the well-illumined one, for ever-fresh well-being.

sanskrit: śuci̱ṁ na yāma̍nn iṣi̱raṁ sva̱rdṛśa̍ṁ ke̱tuṁ di̱vo ro̍cana̱sthām u̍ṣa̱rbudha̍m | a̱gnim mū̱rdhāna̍ṁ di̱vo apra̍tiṣkuta̱ṁ tam ī̍mahe̱ nama̍sā vā̱jina̍m bṛ̱hat ||
english: With reverence we implore the pure one, vigorous in his course, beholder of the sun, beacon stationed in the bright space of heaven, waking at dawn — Agni the summit of the sky, whom none may resist, the greatly mighty.

sanskrit: ma̱ndraṁ hotā̍ra̱ṁ śuci̱m adva̍yāvina̱ṁ damū̍nasam u̱kthya̍ṁ vi̱śvaca̍rṣaṇim | ratha̱ṁ na ci̱traṁ vapu̍ṣāya darśa̱tam manu̍rhita̱ṁ sada̱m id rā̱ya ī̍mahe ||
english: We always implore for wealth the joyful Hotar, the pure one of single purpose, the household god, worthy of praise, beholding all peoples — visible as a bright chariot for beauty, installed by Manu.

sanskrit: vai̱śvā̱na̱rāya̍ pṛthu̱pāja̍se̱ vipo̱ ratnā̍ vidhanta dha̱ruṇe̍ṣu̱ gāta̍ve | a̱gnir hi de̱vām̐ a̱mṛto̍ duva̱syaty athā̱ dharmā̍ṇi sa̱natā̱ na dū̍duṣat ||
english: The inspired ones have placed their precious offerings for Vaiśvānara of wide radiance, for a path among the foundations. For Agni, the immortal, serves the gods, and has not violated the eternal laws.

sanskrit: a̱ntar dū̱to roda̍sī da̱sma ī̍yate̱ hotā̱ niṣa̍tto̱ manu̍ṣaḥ pu̱rohi̍taḥ | kṣaya̍m bṛ̱hanta̱m pari̍ bhūṣati̱ dyubhi̍r de̱vebhi̍r a̱gnir i̍ṣi̱to dhi̱yāva̍suḥ ||
english: The wondrous messenger travels between both worlds; the Hotar, the Purohita of man, is seated. Rich in wisdom, sent by the gods through heavenly days, Agni adorns the great abode.

sanskrit: ke̱tuṁ ya̱jñānā̍ṁ vi̱datha̍sya̱ sādha̍na̱ṁ viprā̍so a̱gnim ma̍hayanta̱ citti̍bhiḥ | apā̍ṁsi̱ yasmi̱nn adhi̍ saṁda̱dhur gira̱s tasmi̍n su̱mnāni̱ yaja̍māna̱ ā ca̍ke ||
english: The inspired ones magnify with their thoughts Agni, the beacon of sacrifices, the accomplisher of the assembly. In him upon whom the poets have joined their songs of praise, the sacrificer delights in favours.

sanskrit: pi̱tā ya̱jñānā̱m asu̍ro vipa̱ścitā̍ṁ vi̱māna̍m a̱gnir va̱yuna̍ṁ ca vā̱ghatā̍m | ā vi̍veśa̱ roda̍sī̱ bhūri̍varpasā purupri̱yo bha̍ndate̱ dhāma̍bhiḥ ka̱viḥ ||
english: Agni, the lord, father of sacrifices, the measurescape and the knowledge of those who praise — the seer of many forms has entered both worlds, a favourite of many; he is glorified with his abodes.

sanskrit: ca̱ndram a̱gniṁ ca̱ndrara̍tha̱ṁ hari̍vrataṁ vaiśvāna̱ram a̍psu̱ṣada̍ṁ sva̱rvida̍m | vi̱gā̱haṁ tūrṇi̱ṁ tavi̍ṣībhi̱r āvṛ̍ta̱m bhūrṇi̍ṁ de̱vāsa̍ i̱ha su̱śriya̍ṁ dadhuḥ ||
english: The gleaming Agni of gleaming chariot, whose vow is golden, Vaiśvānara who dwells in the waters and finds the light, penetrating swiftly and surrounded with mighty powers, fiery — the gods have placed the beautifully splendid one here.

sanskrit: a̱gnir de̱vebhi̱r manu̍ṣaś ca ja̱ntubhi̍s tanvā̱no ya̱jñam pu̍ru̱peśa̍saṁ dhi̱yā | ra̱thīr a̱ntar ī̍yate̱ sādha̍diṣṭibhir jī̱ro damū̍nā abhiśasti̱cāta̍naḥ ||
english: Agni, along with the gods and all mortal beings, fashions by thought the sacrifice of many ornaments. The swift householder travels within, accomplishing his aims as charioteer, averting all attacks.

sanskrit: agne̱ jara̍sva svapa̱tya āyu̍ny ū̱rjā pi̍nvasva̱ sam iṣo̍ didīhi naḥ | vayā̍ṁsi jinva bṛha̱taś ca̍ jāgṛva u̱śig de̱vānā̱m asi̍ su̱kratu̍r vi̱pām ||
english: O Agni, thrive with excellent offspring through the life-spans; swell with strength; kindle our nourishments. Set the branches in motion, vigilant great one; you are the eager one and clear-minded of the gods and of the seers.

sanskrit: vi̱śpati̍ṁ ya̱hvam ati̍thi̱ṁ nara̱ḥ sadā̍ ya̱ntāra̍ṁ dhī̱nām u̱śija̍ṁ ca vā̱ghatā̍m | a̱dhva̱rāṇā̱ṁ ceta̍naṁ jā̱tave̍dasa̱m pra śa̍ṁsanti̱ nama̍sā jū̱tibhi̍r vṛ̱dhe ||
english: The men always extol with reverence and impulses to increase the lord of the clan, the great one, the guest, the guide of thoughts, the zealous one of the praisers, the insightful Knower-of-all-births of the rites.

sanskrit: vi̱bhāvā̍ de̱vaḥ su̱raṇa̱ḥ pari̍ kṣi̱tīr a̱gnir ba̍bhūva̱ śava̍sā su̱madra̍thaḥ ||
english: The broadly-shining god, joyful, has become Agni of great chariot with his might, going beyond all habitations. May we adorn his vows as those who bring him many riches, with our good prayers in the house.

sanskrit: vaiśvā̍nara̱ tava̱ dhāmā̱ny ā ca̍ke̱ yebhi̍ḥ sva̱rvid abha̍vo vicakṣaṇa | jā̱ta āpṛ̍ṇo̱ bhuva̍nāni̱ roda̍sī̱ agne̱ tā viśvā̍ pari̱bhūr a̍si̱ tmanā̍ ||
english: O Vaiśvānara, I delight in your abodes by which you became the discerning finder of light. Being born, you filled all worlds and both spheres; O Agni, you are all-encompassing of yourself.

sanskrit: vai̱śvā̱na̱rasya̍ da̱ṁsanā̍bhyo bṛ̱had ari̍ṇā̱d eka̍ḥ svapa̱syayā̍ ka̱viḥ ||
english: The seer alone has emitted a great stream from the wondrous powers of Vaiśvānara through his own artistry. Agni was born magnifying both parents, heaven and earth, rich in seed.

sanskrit: sa̱mit-sa̍mit su̱manā̍ bodhy a̱sme śu̱cā-śu̍cā suma̱tiṁ rā̍si̱ vasva̍ḥ | ā de̍va de̱vān ya̱jathā̍ya vakṣi̱ sakhā̱ sakhī̍n su̱manā̍ yakṣy agne ||
english: Fuel-stave by fuel-stave, be kindly wakeful for us; flame by flame, bestow favour along with wealth. O god, bring the gods here for the sacrifice; as their friend you shall worship your friends with a good mind, O Agni.

sanskrit: yaṁ de̱vāsa̱s trir aha̍nn ā̱yaja̍nte di̱ve-di̍ve̱ varu̍ṇo mi̱tro a̱gniḥ | semaṁ ya̱jñam madhu̍mantaṁ kṛdhī na̱s tanū̍napād ghṛ̱tayo̍niṁ vi̱dhanta̍m ||
english: The one whom the gods — Varuṇa, Mitra, Agni — honour three times on each day: make this sweet sacrifice of ours, which Tanūnapāt and Ghee-womb have distributed, a success.

sanskrit: pra dīdhi̍tir vi̱śvavā̍rā jigāti̱ hotā̍ram i̱ḻaḥ pra̍tha̱maṁ yaja̍dhyai | acchā̱ namo̍bhir vṛṣa̱bhaṁ va̱ndadhyai̱ sa de̱vān ya̍kṣad iṣi̱to yajī̍yān ||
english: The all-chosen sacred thought goes forth to honour the Hotar as the first for worship. To approach the bull with homages and praise him — so summoned and most sacrificing, let him worship the gods.

sanskrit: ū̱rdhvo vā̍ṁ gā̱tur a̍dhva̱re a̍kāry ū̱rdhvā śo̱cīṁṣi̱ prasthi̍tā̱ rajā̍ṁsi | di̱vo vā̱ nābhā̱ ny a̍sādi̱ hotā̍ stṛṇī̱mahi̍ de̱vavya̍cā̱ vi ba̱rhiḥ ||
english: Your path at the sacrifice has been made upright; the flames have departed upward, reaching the realms. Or the Hotar has been set down at the navel of heaven; we shall strew the sacred grass wide enough for the gods.

sanskrit: sa̱pta ho̱trāṇi̱ mana̍sā vṛṇā̱nā inva̍nto̱ viśva̱m prati̍ yann ṛ̱tena̍ | nṛ̱peśa̍so vi̱dathe̍ṣu̱ pra jā̱tā a̱bhī̱3̱̍maṁ ya̱jñaṁ vi ca̍ranta pū̱rvīḥ ||
english: Choosing the seven priestly functions with the mind, driving all things forward going by the Truth, the many born of man-like appearance among the assemblies have spread out through this sacrifice.

sanskrit: ā bhanda̍māne u̱ṣasā̱ upā̍ke u̱ta sma̍yete ta̱nvā̱3̱̍ virū̍pe | yathā̍ no mi̱tro varu̍ṇo̱ jujo̍ṣa̱d indro̍ ma̱rutvā̍m̐ u̱ta vā̱ maho̍bhiḥ ||
english: As the two Dawns, glorying and nearby, smile with their diverse forms, may Mitra and Varuṇa, and Indra with his Maruts, or the great ones, be delighted with us.

sanskrit: daivyā̱ hotā̍rā pratha̱mā ny ṛ̍ñje sa̱pta pṛ̱kṣāsa̍ḥ sva̱dhayā̍ madanti | ṛ̱taṁ śaṁsa̍nta ṛ̱tam it ta ā̍hu̱r anu̍ vra̱taṁ vra̍ta̱pā dīdhyā̍nāḥ ||
english: I have set in place the two divine Hotars; the seven refreshments exult with their own power. Proclaiming the Truth, they speak only the Truth, meditating on the ordinance as its guardians.

sanskrit: ā bhāra̍tī̱ bhāra̍tībhiḥ sa̱joṣā̱ iḻā̍ de̱vair ma̍nu̱ṣye̍bhir a̱gniḥ | sara̍svatī sārasva̱tebhi̍r a̱rvāk ti̱sro de̱vīr ba̱rhir edaṁ sa̍dantu ||
english: Let Bhāratī with the Bhāratīs, Iḷā in accord with gods and men, Agni, and Sarasvatī together with the Sarasvatīs — let these three goddesses sit on this sacred grass.

sanskrit: tan na̍s tu̱rīpa̱m adha̍ poṣayi̱tnu deva̍ tvaṣṭa̱r vi ra̍rā̱ṇaḥ sya̍sva | yato̍ vī̱raḥ ka̍rma̱ṇya̍ḥ su̱dakṣo̍ yu̱ktagrā̍vā̱ jāya̍te de̱vakā̍maḥ ||
english: O divine Tvaṣṭar, bestow upon us that nourishing, life-sustaining vigour, freely giving; from which a hero is born, active in work, of good skill, who works the pressing-stones and desires the gods.

sanskrit: vana̍spa̱te 'va̍ sṛ̱jopa̍ de̱vān a̱gnir ha̱viḥ śa̍mi̱tā sū̍dayāti | sed u̱ hotā̍ sa̱tyata̍ro yajāti̱ yathā̍ de̱vānā̱ṁ jani̍māni̱ veda̍ ||
english: O Lord of the forest, release the gods; Agni the sacrificer sets the oblation flowing. He alone as Hotar, truer than others, worships as one who knows the origins of the gods.

sanskrit: ā yā̍hy agne samidhā̱no a̱rvāṅ indre̍ṇa de̱vaiḥ sa̱ratha̍ṁ tu̱rebhi̍ḥ | ba̱rhir na̍ āstā̱m adi̍tiḥ supu̱trā svāhā̍ de̱vā a̱mṛtā̍ mādayantām ||
english: Come hither, O Agni, kindled, in the same chariot as swift Indra and the gods. Let Aditi of good sons sit on the sacred grass; let the immortal gods be gladdened with Svāhā.

sanskrit: praty a̱gnir u̱ṣasa̱ś ceki̍tā̱no 'bo̍dhi̱ vipra̍ḥ pada̱vīḥ ka̍vī̱nām | pṛ̱thu̱pājā̍ deva̱yadbhi̱ḥ sami̱ddho 'pa̱ dvārā̱ tama̍so̱ vahni̍r āvaḥ ||
english: Agni, alert as the Dawns, the inspired seer, woke and became aware of the paths of the seers. Kindled with wide brilliance by the god-fearing, the conveyor has opened the doors of darkness.

sanskrit: pred v a̱gnir vā̍vṛdhe̱ stome̍bhir gī̱rbhiḥ sto̍tṝ̱ṇāṁ na̍ma̱sya̍ u̱kthaiḥ | pū̱rvīr ṛ̱tasya̍ sa̱ṁdṛśa̍ś cakā̱naḥ saṁ dū̱to a̍dyaud u̱ṣaso̍ viro̱ke ||
english: Agni has indeed grown through the praises of the singers, with their songs and lauds worthy of homage. Delighting in many visions of the Truth, the messenger has shone forth together with the breaking of the Dawns.

sanskrit: adhā̍yy a̱gnir mānu̍ṣīṣu vi̱kṣv a1̱̍pāṁ garbho̍ mi̱tra ṛ̱tena̱ sādha̍n | ā ha̍rya̱to ya̍ja̱taḥ sānv a̍sthā̱d abhū̍d u̱ vipro̱ havyo̍ matī̱nām ||
english: Agni has been placed in human clans — the embryo of the waters, like Mitra, accomplishing by the Truth. The desirable and worshipful one has stood upon the ridge; the inspired one has become worthy of offerings of the prayers.

sanskrit: mi̱tro a̱gnir bha̍vati̱ yat sami̍ddho mi̱tro hotā̱ varu̍ṇo jā̱tave̍dāḥ | mi̱tro a̍dhva̱ryur i̍ṣi̱ro damū̍nā mi̱traḥ sindhū̍nām u̱ta parva̍tānām ||
english: Agni becomes Mitra when kindled; the Hotar, the Knower-of-all-births, is Varuṇa. The vigorous householder as Adhvaryu is Mitra; he is Mitra of the rivers and of the mountains.

sanskrit: pāti̍ pri̱yaṁ ri̱po agra̍m pa̱daṁ veḥ pāti̍ ya̱hvaś cara̍ṇa̱ṁ sūrya̍sya | pāti̱ nābhā̍ sa̱ptaśī̍rṣāṇam a̱gniḥ pāti̍ de̱vānā̍m upa̱māda̍m ṛ̱ṣvaḥ ||
english: He guards the dear foremost step of the thievish bird; the great one guards the course of the sun. Agni, sublime, guards at the navel the seven-headed one; he guards the highest seat of the gods.

sanskrit: ṛ̱bhuś ca̍kra̱ īḍy̱ṛaṁ cāru̱ nāma̱ viśvā̍ni de̱vo va̱yunā̍ni vi̱dvān | sa̱sasya̱ carma̍ ghṛ̱tava̍t pa̱daṁ ves tad id a̱gnī ra̍kṣa̱ty apra̍yucchan ||
english: The skillful Ṛbhu has made the praiseworthy and lovely name; the god knows all the guidance-signs. He has lain on the skin of the grain, the ghee-rich step of the bird — that Agni guards without wavering.

sanskrit: ā yoni̍m a̱gnir ghṛ̱tava̍ntam asthāt pṛ̱thupra̍gāṇam u̱śanta̍m uśā̱naḥ | dīdyā̍na̱ḥ śuci̍r ṛ̱ṣvaḥ pā̍va̱kaḥ puna̍ḥ-punar mā̱tarā̱ navya̍sī kaḥ ||
english: Agni, desirous, has taken his place in the ghee-rich womb, widely extending and longed-for. Blazing, pure, sublime, and purifying, he renews the two mothers again and again.

sanskrit: sa̱dyo jā̱to oṣa̍dhībhir vavakṣe̱ yadī̱ vardha̍nti pra̱svo̍ ghṛ̱tena̍ | āpa̍ iva pra̱vatā̱ śumbha̍mānā uru̱ṣyad a̱gniḥ pi̱tror u̱pasthe̍ ||
english: Newly born, he has swelled with the plants when the wombs nourish with ghee. Like waters shining down a slope, Agni blazes in the lap of the parents, keeping them safe.

sanskrit: ud u̍ ṣṭu̱taḥ sa̱midhā̍ ya̱hvo a̍dyau̱d varṣma̍n di̱vo adhi̱ nābhā̍ pṛthi̱vyāḥ | mi̱tro a̱gnir īḍyo̍ māta̱riśvā dū̱to va̍kṣad ya̱jathā̍ya de̱vān ||
english: Praised, the great one has blazed upward, kindled with fuel, at the summit of heaven and the navel of the earth. Agni is Mitra, worthy of praise; as Mātariśvan the messenger he shall bring the gods for worship.

sanskrit: ud a̍stambhīt sa̱midhā̱ nāka̍m ṛ̱ṣvo̱3̱̍ 'gnir bhava̍nn utta̱mo ro̍ca̱nānā̍m | yadī̱ bhṛgu̍bhya̱ḥ pari̍ māta̱riśvā̱ guhā̱ santa̍ṁ havya̱vāha̍ṁ samī̱dhe ||
english: Sublime Agni, being the highest among the shining ones, has propped up the vault of heaven with his fuel. When Mātariśvan kindled from the Bhṛgus the hidden carrier of oblations.

sanskrit: iḻā̍m agne puru̱daṁsa̍ṁ sa̱niṁ goḥ śa̍śvatta̱maṁ hava̍mānāya sādha | syān na̍ḥ sū̱nus tana̍yo vi̱jāvāgne̱ sā te̍ suma̱tir bhū̍tv a̱sme ||
english: O Agni, accomplish for the worshipper Iḷā of many wonders, the ever-abiding winning of the cow. May there be for us a son and offspring rich in descendants; O Agni, may that favour of yours be upon us.

sanskrit: pra kā̍ravo mana̱nā va̱cyamā̍nā deva̱drīcī̍ṁ nayata deva̱yanta̍ḥ | da̱kṣi̱ṇā̱vāḍ vā̱jinī̱ prācy e̍ti ha̱vir bhara̍nty a̱gnaye̍ ghṛ̱tācī̍ ||
english: The Kārus, being celebrated with thoughts, lead forward toward the divine as god-seekers. The prize-bearing, hymn-strong one goes eastward carrying oblation; the ghee-pouring one goes south to Agni.

sanskrit: ā roda̍sī apṛṇā̱ jāya̍māna u̱ta pra ri̍kthā̱ adha̱ nu pra̍yajyo | di̱vaś ci̍d agne mahi̱nā pṛ̍thi̱vyā va̱cyantā̍ṁ te̱ vahna̍yaḥ sa̱ptaji̍hvāḥ ||
english: Being born, you filled both worlds, and then left them to be enjoyed; now, O adorable one, let your seven-tongued conveyors be celebrated with your greatness of heaven and earth.

sanskrit: dyauś ca̍ tvā pṛthi̱vī ya̱jñiyā̍so̱ ni hotā̍raṁ sādayante̱ damā̍ya | yadī̱ viśo̱ mānu̍ṣīr deva̱yantī̱ḥ praya̍svatī̱r īḻa̍te śu̱kram a̱rciḥ ||
english: Heaven and earth, worthy of worship, set you down as Hotar for the house. When human tribes, desiring the gods, rich in offerings, invoke the bright flame.

sanskrit: ma̱hān sa̱dhasthe̍ dhru̱va ā niṣa̍tto̱ 'ntar dyāvā̱ māhi̍ne̱ harya̍māṇaḥ | āskre̍ sa̱patnī̍ a̱jare̱ amṛ̍kte saba̱rdughe̍ urugā̱yasya̍ dhe̱nū ||
english: The great one, fixed, has sat down firmly in his common seat, between great heaven and earth, being praised. In the lap sit the two co-wives, unaging and immortal, milk-cows of the far-ranging one who milk together.

sanskrit: vra̱tā te̍ agne maha̱to ma̱hāni̱ tava̱ kratvā̱ roda̍sī̱ ā ta̍tantha | tvaṁ dū̱to a̍bhavo̱ jāya̍māna̱s tvaṁ ne̱tā vṛ̍ṣabha carṣaṇī̱nām ||
english: Your vows, O Agni, are great and mighty; by your will you have stretched out both world-halves. You became the messenger at birth; you are the leader, O bull, of human beings.

sanskrit: ṛ̱tasya̍ vā ke̱śinā̍ yo̱gyābhi̍r ghṛta̱snuvā̱ rohi̍tā dhu̱ri dhi̍ṣva | athā va̍ha de̱vān de̍va̱ viśvā̍n svadhva̱rā kṛ̍ṇuhi jātavedaḥ ||
english: Harness Ṛta's two long-maned, yoke-fitting, ghee-dripping red steeds to the chariot-pole. Then bring all the gods, O divine Jātavedas, make the sacrifice well-performed.

sanskrit: di̱vaś ci̱d ā te̍ rucayanta ro̱kā u̱ṣo vi̍bhā̱tīr anu̍ bhāsi pū̱rvīḥ | a̱po yad a̍gna u̱śadha̱g vane̍ṣu̱ hotu̍r ma̱ndrasya̍ pa̱naya̍nta de̱vāḥ ||
english: From heaven itself your flames shine out; you illumine many dawns as they blaze forth. When you, O Agni, glow with longing in the forests, the gods marvel at the joyful Hotar.

sanskrit: u̱rau vā̱ ye a̱ntari̍kṣe̱ mada̍nti di̱vo vā̱ ye ro̍ca̱ne santi̍ de̱vāḥ | ūmā̍ vā̱ ye su̱havā̍so̱ yaja̍trā āyemi̱re ra̱thyo̍ agne̱ aśvā̍ḥ ||
english: Whether gods exult in the wide atmosphere, or are in the bright space of heaven, or those of easy invocation, worthy of worship who are helpers — all like chariot horses have come to you, O Agni.

sanskrit: aibhi̍r agne sa̱ratha̍ṁ yāhy a̱rvāṅ nā̍nāra̱thaṁ vā̍ vi̱bhavo̱ hy aśvā̍ḥ | patnī̍vatas tri̱ṁśata̱ṁ trīm̐ś ca̍ de̱vān a̍nuṣva̱dham ā va̍ha mā̱daya̍sva ||
english: Come hither, O Agni, in the same chariot with these, or in separate chariots — for the horses are many. Bring the thirty-three gods with their wives in proper order; be gladdened.

sanskrit: sa hotā̱ yasya̱ roda̍sī cid u̱rvī ya̱jñaṁ-ya̍jñam a̱bhi vṛ̱dhe gṛ̍ṇī̱taḥ | prācī̍ adhva̱reva̍ tasthatuḥ su̱meke̍ ṛ̱tāva̍rī ṛ̱tajā̍tasya sa̱tye ||
english: He is the Hotar for whom even the two broad worlds speak praise for the increase of every sacrifice. Both stand firm, fair and eastward like a rite — the two truth-containing ones in the truth of the one born of Truth.

sanskrit: iḻā̍m agne puru̱daṁsa̍ṁ sa̱niṁ goḥ śa̍śvatta̱maṁ hava̍mānāya sādha | syān na̍ḥ sū̱nus tana̍yo vi̱jāvāgne̱ sā te̍ suma̱tir bhū̍tv a̱sme ||
english: O Agni, accomplish for the worshipper Iḷā of many wonders, the ever-abiding winning of the cow. May there be for us a son and offspring rich in descendants; O Agni, may that favour of yours be upon us.

sanskrit: pra ya ā̱ruḥ śi̍tipṛ̱ṣṭhasya̍ dhā̱ser ā mā̱tarā̍ viviśuḥ sa̱pta vāṇī̍ḥ | pa̱ri̱kṣitā̍ pi̱tarā̱ saṁ ca̍rete̱ pra sa̍rsrāte dī̱rgham āyu̍ḥ pra̱yakṣe̍ ||
english: The seven voices have climbed up and entered the two mothers of the white-backed one's stream. The two all-encircling parents travel together and pour forth long life for worship.

sanskrit: di̱vakṣa̍so dhe̱navo̱ vṛṣṇo̱ aśvā̍ de̱vīr ā ta̍sthau̱ madhu̍ma̱d vaha̍ntīḥ | ṛ̱tasya̍ tvā̱ sada̍si kṣema̱yanta̱m pary ekā̍ carati varta̱niṁ gauḥ ||
english: The divine milk-cows, the horses of the bull, sky-nourishing, bearing sweetness, have stood at their station. Around you, at rest in the seat of Ṛta, one cow walks the path.

sanskrit: ā sī̍m arohat su̱yamā̱ bhava̍ntī̱ḥ pati̍ś ciki̱tvān ra̍yi̱vid ra̍yī̱ṇām | pra nīla̍pṛṣṭho ata̱sasya̍ dhā̱ses tā a̍vāsayat puru̱dhapra̍tīkaḥ ||
english: They climbed up, becoming easily yoked; the knowing master, finder of riches. The blue-backed one kindled the stream of the desert plant; the many-formed one has made them blaze.

sanskrit: mahi̍ tvā̱ṣṭram ū̱rjaya̍ntīr aju̱ryaṁ sta̍bhū̱yamā̍naṁ va̱hato̍ vahanti | vy aṅge̍bhir didyutā̱naḥ sa̱dhastha̱ ekā̍m iva̱ roda̍sī̱ ā vi̍veśa ||
english: The vigorous ones carry the great work of Tvaṣṭar, imperishable and holding firm. Flashing through his limbs in the common seat, he has entered the two worlds as if they were one.

sanskrit: jā̱nanti̱ vṛṣṇo̍ aru̱ṣasya̱ śeva̍m u̱ta bra̱dhnasya̱ śāsa̍ne raṇanti | di̱vo̱ruca̍ḥ su̱ruco̱ roca̍mānā̱ iḻā̱ yeṣā̱ṁ gaṇyā̱ māhi̍nā̱ gīḥ ||
english: They know the delight of the ruddy bull; they rejoice at the command of the tawny one. Shining with the lights of heaven, brilliantly shining — their glorious, great song is Iḷā.

sanskrit: u̱to pi̱tṛbhyā̍m pra̱vidānu̱ ghoṣa̍m ma̱ho ma̱hadbhyā̍m anayanta śū̱ṣam | u̱kṣā ha̱ yatra̱ pari̱ dhāna̍m a̱ktor anu̱ svaṁ dhāma̍ jari̱tur va̱vakṣa̍ ||
english: From the two great parents, following the call, they have led the strength. The bull has laid its sheath on the night; it has swelled following the praiser's own abode.

sanskrit: a̱dhva̱ryubhi̍ḥ pa̱ñcabhi̍ḥ sa̱pta viprā̍ḥ pri̱yaṁ ra̍kṣante̱ nihi̍tam pa̱daṁ veḥ | prāñco̍ madanty u̱kṣaṇo̍ aju̱ryā de̱vā de̱vānā̱m anu̱ hi vra̱tā guḥ ||
english: Seven inspired ones with five Adhvaryus guard the beloved hidden step of the bird. The ageless bulls exult going forward; the gods have followed the divine ordinances.

sanskrit: daivyā̱ hotā̍rā pratha̱mā ny ṛ̍ñje sa̱pta pṛ̱kṣāsa̍ḥ sva̱dhayā̍ madanti | ṛ̱taṁ śaṁsa̍nta ṛ̱tam it ta ā̍hu̱r anu̍ vra̱taṁ vra̍ta̱pā dīdhyā̍nāḥ ||
english: I have set in place the two divine Hotars foremost; the seven refreshments exult with their own power. Proclaiming the Truth, they speak only the Truth, meditating on the ordinance as its guardians.

sanskrit: vṛ̱ṣā̱yante̍ ma̱he atyā̍ya pū̱rvīr vṛṣṇe̍ ci̱trāya̍ ra̱śmaya̍ḥ suyā̱māḥ ||
english: Many rays well-steered for the great swift steed, for the brilliant bull, are being bullish. O divine Hotar, more gladdening and discerning, bring the great gods and both worlds here.

sanskrit: pṛ̱kṣapra̍yajo draviṇaḥ su̱vāca̍ḥ suke̱tava̍ u̱ṣaso̍ re̱vad ū̍ṣuḥ | u̱to ci̍d agne mahi̱nā pṛ̍thi̱vyāḥ kṛ̱taṁ ci̱d ena̱ḥ sam ma̱he da̍śasya ||
english: Wealthy, of fair speech, with good beacons, the offering-rich ones have shone brilliantly at the Dawns. But even the sin that has been done, O Agni, do thou remit by the greatness of the earth.

sanskrit: iḻā̍m agne puru̱daṁsa̍ṁ sa̱niṁ goḥ śa̍śvatta̱maṁ hava̍mānāya sādha | syān na̍ḥ sū̱nus tana̍yo vi̱jāvāgne̱ sā te̍ suma̱tir bhū̍tv a̱sme ||
english: O Agni, accomplish for the worshipper Iḷā of many wonders, the ever-abiding winning of the cow. May there be for us a son and offspring rich in descendants; O Agni, may that favour of yours be upon us.

sanskrit: a̱ñjanti̱ tvām a̍dhva̱re de̍va̱yanto̱ vana̍spate̱ madhu̍nā̱ daivye̍na | yad ū̱rdhvas tiṣṭhā̱ dravi̍ṇe̱ha dha̍ttā̱d yad vā̱ kṣayo̍ mā̱tur a̱syā u̱pasthe̍ ||
english: God-fearing men anoint you at the sacrifice with divine sweetness, O Lord of the forest — whether you stand erect, placing wealth here, or whether your resting-place is in this your mother's lap.

sanskrit: sami̍ddhasya̱ śraya̍māṇaḥ pu̱rastā̱d brahma̍ vanvā̱no a̱jara̍ṁ su̱vīra̍m | ā̱re a̱smad ama̍ti̱m bādha̍māna̱ uc chra̍yasva maha̱te saubha̍gāya ||
english: Leaning in front of the kindled one, winning unaging and excellent manly strength with sacred speech — pushing poverty far from us, rise up for great good fortune.

sanskrit: uc chra̍yasva vanaspate̱ varṣma̍n pṛthi̱vyā adhi̍ | sumi̍tī mī̱yamā̍no̱ varco̍ dhā ya̱jñavā̍hase ||
english: Rise up, O Lord of the forest, upon the height of earth. Being well-trimmed, bestow vigour on the one who carries the sacrifice.

sanskrit: yuvā̍ su̱vāsā̱ḥ pari̍vīta̱ āgā̱t sa u̱ śreyā̍n bhavati̱ jāya̍mānaḥ | taṁ dhīrā̍saḥ ka̱vaya̱ un na̍yanti svā̱dhyo̱3̱̍ mana̍sā deva̱yanta̍ḥ ||
english: The youth, well-clad and adorned, has come; he becomes more excellent as he is born. The steadfast seers who are of good insight, who desire the gods with their mind, lead him up.

sanskrit: jā̱to jā̍yate sudina̱tve ahnā̍ṁ sama̱rya ā vi̱dathe̱ vardha̍mānaḥ | pu̱nanti̱ dhīrā̍ a̱paso̍ manī̱ṣā de̍va̱yā vipra̱ ud i̍yarti̱ vāca̍m ||
english: Born, he is being born in the goodly daylight of the days, growing in the contest in the assembly. The steadfast ones purify their works with wisdom; the inspired one, devoted to the gods, raises the voice.

sanskrit: yān vo̱ naro̍ deva̱yanto̍ nimi̱myur vana̍spate̱ svadhi̍tir vā ta̱takṣa̍ | te de̱vāsa̱ḥ svara̍vas tasthi̱vāṁsa̍ḥ pra̱jāva̍d a̱sme di̍dhiṣantu̱ ratna̍m ||
english: The posts which the god-fearing men have fixed, O Lord of the forest, or which the axe has hewn — may the gods, self-luminous, established in them, bestow upon us a treasure rich in offspring.

sanskrit: ye vṛ̱kṇāso̱ adhi̱ kṣami̱ nimi̍tāso ya̱tasru̍caḥ | te no̍ vyantu̱ vārya̍ṁ deva̱trā kṣe̍tra̱sādha̍saḥ ||
english: Those cut down and set in the earth with ladles extended — may they, the accomplishers of the sacred ground, obtain for us among the gods the desired prize.

sanskrit: ā̱di̱tyā ru̱drā vasa̍vaḥ sunī̱thā dyāvā̱kṣāmā̍ pṛthi̱vī a̱ntari̍kṣam | sa̱joṣa̍so ya̱jñam a̍vantu de̱vā ū̱rdhvaṁ kṛ̍ṇvantv adhva̱rasya̍ ke̱tum ||
english: The Ādityas, Rudras, Vasus, of fair guidance, heaven and earth, the atmosphere — may the gods of one accord protect the sacrifice; may they raise high the beacon of the rite.

sanskrit: ha̱ṁsā i̍va śreṇi̱śo yatā̍nāḥ śu̱krā vasā̍nā̱ḥ svara̍vo na̱ āgu̍ḥ | u̱nnī̱yamā̍nāḥ ka̱vibhi̍ḥ pu̱rastā̍d de̱vā de̱vānā̱m api̍ yanti̱ pātha̍ḥ ||
english: Like geese moving in a line, white-clad and self-luminous, they have come to us. Led up forward by the seers, the gods are going to the realm of the gods.

sanskrit: śṛṅgā̍ṇī̱vec chṛ̱ṅgiṇā̱ṁ saṁ da̍dṛśre ca̱ṣāla̍vanta̱ḥ svara̍vaḥ pṛthi̱vyām | vā̱ghadbhi̍r vā viha̱ve śroṣa̍māṇā a̱smām̐ a̍vantu pṛta̱nājye̍ṣu ||
english: The self-luminous ones with their capitals, like horns among the horned, are seen on the earth. Listening to the call of the praisers, may they aid us in the winning of battles.

sanskrit: vana̍spate śa̱tava̍lśo̱ vi ro̍ha sa̱hasra̍valśā̱ vi va̱yaṁ ru̍hema | yaṁ tvām a̱yaṁ svadhi̍ti̱s teja̍mānaḥ praṇi̱nāya̍ maha̱te saubha̍gāya ||
english: O Lord of the forest, grow with a hundred branches; may we grow with a thousand branches. May this whetted axe that has shaped you bring great good fortune.

sanskrit: sakhā̍yas tvā vavṛmahe de̱vam martā̍sa ū̱taye̍ | a̱pāṁ napā̍taṁ su̱bhaga̍ṁ su̱dīdi̍tiṁ su̱pratū̍rtim ane̱hasa̍m ||
english: We, mortals as friends, have chosen you, the divine, for our aid — Grandson of the Waters, the blessed, the clearly-blazing, the easily-victorious, the faultless.

sanskrit: kāya̍māno va̱nā tvaṁ yan mā̱tṝr aja̍gann a̱paḥ | na tat te̍ agne pra̱mṛṣe̍ ni̱varta̍na̱ṁ yad dū̱re sann i̱hābha̍vaḥ ||
english: Longing for the forests, you went and entered the mother waters; O Agni, your return cannot be forgotten — that, being far away, you were present here.

sanskrit: ati̍ tṛ̱ṣṭaṁ va̍vakṣi̱thāthai̱va su̱manā̍ asi | pra-prā̱nye yanti̱ pary a̱nya ā̍sate̱ yeṣā̍ṁ sa̱khye asi̍ śri̱taḥ ||
english: You have borne even what is sharp and bitter, and still you are well-disposed. Some go forward and forward; others sit around — those on whose friendship you depend.

sanskrit: ī̱yi̱vāṁsa̱m ati̱ sridha̱ḥ śaśva̍tī̱r ati̍ sa̱ścata̍ḥ | anv ī̍m avindan nici̱rāso̍ a̱druho̱ 'psu si̱ṁham i̍va śri̱tam ||
english: He who had gone past many failures, past those who persistently hated him — the wise and guileless ones found him, established in the waters like a lion.

sanskrit: sa̱sṛ̱vāṁsa̍m iva̱ tmanā̱gnim i̱tthā ti̱rohi̍tam | aina̍ṁ nayan māta̱riśvā̍ parā̱vato̍ de̱vebhyo̍ mathi̱tam pari̍ ||
english: Mātariśvan led this Agni, who was thus hidden as though fleeing on his own, from afar — churned for the gods from the distance.

sanskrit: taṁ tvā̱ martā̍ agṛbhṇata de̱vebhyo̍ havyavāhana | viśvā̱n yad ya̱jñām̐ a̍bhi̱pāsi̍ mānuṣa̱ tava̱ kratvā̍ yaviṣṭhya ||
english: Mortals have seized you, O carrier of oblations, for the gods — O youngest, by your will you oversee all human sacrifices.

sanskrit: tad bha̱draṁ tava̍ da̱ṁsanā̱ pākā̍ya cic chadayati | tvāṁ yad a̍gne pa̱śava̍ḥ sa̱māsa̍te̱ sami̍ddham apiśarva̱re ||
english: That your wondrous power is pleasing even to the simple one — when, O Agni, the animals sit around you, kindled on the dark night.

sanskrit: ā ju̍hotā svadhva̱raṁ śī̱ram pā̍va̱kaśo̍ciṣam | ā̱śuṁ dū̱tam a̍ji̱ram pra̱tnam īḍy̱aṁ śru̱ṣṭī de̱vaṁ sa̍paryata ||
english: Pour the oblation to the self-performing sacrificer, the fierce one of pure flame. Attend with offerings to the swift messenger, the quick, ancient, praiseworthy, helpful deity.

sanskrit: trīṇi̍ śa̱tā trī sa̱hasrā̍ṇy a̱gniṁ tri̱ṁśac ca̍ de̱vā nava̍ cāsaparyan | aukṣa̍n ghṛ̱tair astṛ̍ṇan ba̱rhir a̍smā̱ ād id dhotā̍ra̱ṁ ny a̍sādayanta ||
english: Three hundred, three thousand, and thirty-nine gods have served Agni. They sprinkled him with ghees and strewed the sacred grass for him; then at last they seated him as Hotar.

sanskrit: tvām a̍gne manī̱ṣiṇa̍ḥ sa̱mrāja̍ṁ carṣaṇī̱nām | de̱vam martā̍sa indhate̱ sam a̍dhva̱re ||
english: You, O Agni, the thoughtful mortals kindle at the sacrifice — the universal king of peoples, the divine one.

sanskrit: tvāṁ ya̱jñeṣv ṛ̱tvija̱m agne̱ hotā̍ram īḻate | go̱pā ṛ̱tasya̍ dīdihi̱ sve dame̍ ||
english: You, O Agni, they invoke at sacrifices as Hotar and seasonal priest. O guardian of the Truth, blaze in your own house.

sanskrit: sa ghā̱ yas te̱ dadā̍śati sa̱midhā̍ jā̱tave̍dase | so a̍gne dhatte su̱vīrya̱ṁ sa pu̍ṣyati ||
english: He who pays homage to you, O Knower-of-all-births, with fuel — that man, O Agni, obtains excellent manly strength; he flourishes.

sanskrit: sa ke̱tur a̍dhva̱rāṇā̍m a̱gnir de̱vebhi̱r ā ga̍mat | a̱ñjā̱naḥ sa̱pta hotṛ̍bhir ha̱viṣma̍te ||
english: That Agni, the beacon of the rites, shall come with the gods, anointed with seven Hotars, to him who holds the oblation.

sanskrit: pra hotre̍ pū̱rvyaṁ vaco̱ 'gnaye̍ bharatā bṛ̱hat ||
english: Carry forth to the Hotar's office the mighty ancient speech for Agni, who bears the lights of the seers and the seer-gift.

sanskrit: a̱gniṁ va̍rdhantu no̱ giro̱ yato̱ jāya̍ta u̱kthya̍ḥ | ma̱he vājā̍ya̱ dravi̍ṇāya darśa̱taḥ ||
english: May our songs increase Agni, from whom the lauded one is born — the visible one, for great vigour and wealth.

sanskrit: agne̱ yaji̍ṣṭho adhva̱re de̱vān de̍vaya̱te ya̍ja | hotā̍ ma̱ndro vi rā̍ja̱sy ati̱ sridha̍ḥ ||
english: O Agni, most skilled at the rite, worship the gods for the god-fearing man. The joyful Hotar, you shine beyond the failures.

sanskrit: sa na̍ḥ pāvaka dīdihi dyu̱mad a̱sme su̱vīrya̍m | bhavā̍ sto̱tṛbhyo̱ anta̍maḥ sva̱staye̍ ||
english: O purifier, blaze out for us luminously; for us be there excellent heroic strength. Be the nearest to the praisers for their well-being.

sanskrit: taṁ tvā̱ viprā̍ vipa̱nyavo̍ jāgṛ̱vāṁsa̱ḥ sam i̍ndhate | ha̱vya̱vāha̱m ama̍rtyaṁ saho̱vṛdha̍m ||
english: The inspired, greatly-praising ones, vigilant, kindle you — the immortal carrier of oblations who grows with might.

sanskrit: a̱gnir hotā̍ pu̱rohi̍to 'dhva̱rasya̱ vica̍rṣaṇiḥ | sa ve̍da ya̱jñam ā̍nu̱ṣak ||
english: Agni is the Hotar and Purohita of the rite, the all-seeing one. He knows the sacrifice in proper order.

sanskrit: sa ha̍vya̱vāḻ ama̍rtya u̱śig dū̱taś cano̍hitaḥ | a̱gnir dhi̱yā sam ṛ̍ṇvati ||
english: He is the immortal carrier of oblations, the eager messenger delightful in food — Agni is set in motion by wisdom.

sanskrit: a̱gnir dhi̱yā sa ce̍tati ke̱tur ya̱jñasya̍ pū̱rvyaḥ | artha̱ṁ hy a̍sya ta̱raṇi̍ ||
english: Agni is aware through wisdom; he is the first and foremost beacon of the sacrifice. For his boat crosses to the goal.

sanskrit: a̱gniṁ sū̱nuṁ sana̍śruta̱ṁ saha̍so jā̱tave̍dasam | vahni̍ṁ de̱vā a̍kṛṇvata ||
english: The gods have made Agni, the son of strength, the Knower-of-all-births praised of old, their conveyor.

sanskrit: adā̍bhyaḥ purae̱tā vi̱śām a̱gnir mānu̍ṣīṇām | tūrṇī̱ ratha̱ḥ sadā̱ nava̍ḥ ||
english: Agni is the inviolable forerunner of human clans — the chariot always swift and ever new.

sanskrit: sā̱hvān viśvā̍ abhi̱yuja̱ḥ kratu̍r de̱vānā̱m amṛ̍ktaḥ | a̱gnis tu̱viśra̍vastamaḥ ||
english: Agni, unimpeded, who has overcome all challengers, the will of the gods — Agni of the most widespread fame.

sanskrit: a̱bhi prayā̍ṁsi̱ vāha̍sā dā̱śvām̐ a̍śnoti̱ martya̍ḥ | kṣaya̍m pāva̱kaśo̍ciṣaḥ ||
english: The mortal who has sacrificed wins the gifts and the chariot-load — the abode of the one of pure flame.

sanskrit: pari̱ viśvā̍ni̱ sudhi̍tā̱gner a̍śyāma̱ manma̍bhiḥ | viprā̍so jā̱tave̍dasaḥ ||
english: We, inspired ones, may reach with our prayers all the well-placed gifts of Agni, the Knower-of-all-births.

sanskrit: agne̱ viśvā̍ni̱ vāryā̱ vāje̍ṣu saniṣāmahe | tve de̱vāsa̱ eri̍re ||
english: O Agni, we shall win all desirable things in the contest; the gods have roused themselves in you.

sanskrit: indrā̍gnī̱ ā ga̍taṁ su̱taṁ gī̱rbhir nabho̱ vare̍ṇyam | a̱sya pā̍taṁ dhi̱yeṣi̱tā ||
english: O Indra and Agni, come with songs to the pressed soma, to the excellent one of the clouds. You who are sent by prayer — drink of this.

sanskrit: indrā̍gnī jari̱tuḥ sacā̍ ya̱jño ji̍gāti̱ ceta̍naḥ | a̱yā pā̍tam i̱maṁ su̱tam ||
english: O Indra and Agni, the conscious sacrifice goes forward together with the singer. Drink of this pressed soma.

sanskrit: indra̍m a̱gniṁ ka̍vi̱cchadā̍ ya̱jñasya̍ jū̱tyā vṛ̍ṇe | tā soma̍sye̱ha tṛ̍mpatām ||
english: With the swiftness of the sacrifice I choose Indra and Agni as shelter of the seer. Let the two of them here be satisfied with the soma.

sanskrit: to̱śā vṛ̍tra̱haṇā̍ huve sa̱jitvā̱nāpa̍rājitā | i̱ndrā̱gnī vā̍ja̱sāta̍mā ||
english: I invoke the two most effective, the slayers of Vṛtra, the two who always conquer and are never defeated — Indra and Agni, the most winning of prizes.

sanskrit: pra vā̍m arcanty u̱kthino̍ nīthā̱vido̍ jari̱tāra̍ḥ | indrā̍gnī̱ iṣa̱ ā vṛ̍ṇe ||
english: The singers who know the hymns, who praise with lauds, praise the two of you. I choose refreshment from Indra and Agni.

sanskrit: indrā̍gnī nava̱tim puro̍ dā̱sapa̍tnīr adhūnutam | sā̱kam eke̍na̱ karma̍ṇā ||
english: Indra and Agni shook down ninety strongholds ruled by Dāsas — together with a single deed.

sanskrit: indrā̍gnī̱ apa̍sa̱s pary upa̱ pra ya̍nti dhī̱taya̍ḥ | ṛ̱tasya̍ pa̱thyā̱3̱̍ anu̍ ||
english: The prayers go forward and around the works of Indra and Agni, following the paths of the Truth.

sanskrit: indrā̍gnī tavi̱ṣāṇi̍ vāṁ sa̱dhasthā̍ni̱ prayā̍ṁsi ca | yu̱vor a̱ptūrya̍ṁ hi̱tam ||
english: O Indra and Agni, your mighty common seats and gifts — what prize of the water-filling is placed within you both.

sanskrit: indrā̍gnī roca̱nā di̱vaḥ pari̱ vāje̍ṣu bhūṣathaḥ | tad vā̍ṁ ceti̱ pra vī̱rya̍m ||
english: O Indra and Agni, you adorn the shining spaces of heaven in the prizes. That heroic power of yours is clearly visible.

sanskrit: pra vo̍ de̱vāyā̱gnaye̱ barhi̍ṣṭham arcāsmai | gama̍d de̱vebhi̱r ā sa no̱ yaji̍ṣṭho ba̱rhir ā sa̍dat ||
english: Sing forth the highest praise to the divine Agni; may the most skilled sacrificer come to us with the gods and sit on the sacred grass.

sanskrit: ṛ̱tāvā̱ yasya̱ roda̍sī̱ dakṣa̱ṁ saca̍nta ū̱taya̍ḥ | ha̱viṣma̍nta̱s tam ī̍ḻate̱ taṁ sa̍ni̱ṣyanto 'va̍se ||
english: The law-abiding one whose both worlds and aids accompany his skill — those who have offerings invoke him; those seeking to win invoke him for protection.

sanskrit: sa ya̱ntā vipra̍ eṣā̱ṁ sa ya̱jñānā̱m athā̱ hi ṣaḥ | a̱gniṁ taṁ vo̍ duvasyata̱ dātā̱ yo vani̍tā ma̱gham ||
english: He is the guide of these inspired ones and of their sacrifices — for it is truly so. Honour that Agni who is the giver and winner of bounty.

sanskrit: sa na̱ḥ śarmā̍ṇi vī̱taye̱ 'gnir ya̍cchatu̱ śaṁta̍mā | yato̍ naḥ pru̱ṣṇava̱d vasu̍ di̱vi kṣi̱tibhyo̍ a̱psv ā ||
english: Let Agni grant us the most beneficent shelters for our enjoyment — from which refreshing wealth comes to us from heaven, from the sky, from the waters.

sanskrit: dī̱di̱vāṁsa̱m apū̍rvya̱ṁ vasvī̍bhir asya dhī̱tibhi̍ḥ | ṛkvā̍ṇo a̱gnim i̍ndhate̱ hotā̍raṁ vi̱śpati̍ṁ vi̱śām ||
english: The reciters kindle with his auspicious thoughts the unrivalled blazing Agni, the Hotar and lord of the clans.

sanskrit: u̱ta no̱ brahma̍nn aviṣa u̱ktheṣu̍ deva̱hūta̍maḥ | śaṁ na̍ḥ śocā ma̱rudvṛ̱dho 'gne̍ sahasra̱sāta̍maḥ ||
english: Moreover, O priest, be beneficent to us in our lauds, O most invoked of gods. O Agni, who grows with the Maruts, most winning of thousands, blaze out auspiciously for us.

sanskrit: nū no̍ rāsva sa̱hasra̍vat to̱kava̍t puṣṭi̱mad vasu̍ | dyu̱mad a̍gne su̱vīrya̱ṁ varṣi̍ṣṭha̱m anu̍pakṣitam ||
english: Now give us wealth thousandfold, rich in offspring and nourishment. O Agni, luminous excellent heroic strength, the highest and never wasting away.

sanskrit: ā hotā̍ ma̱ndro vi̱dathā̍ny asthāt sa̱tyo yajvā̍ ka̱vita̍ma̱ḥ sa ve̱dhāḥ | vi̱dyudra̍tha̱ḥ saha̍sas pu̱tro a̱gniḥ śo̱ciṣke̍śaś pṛthi̱vyām pājo̍ aśret ||
english: The joyful Hotar has taken his place in the assemblies — the true sacrificer, the most seer-like, the wise one. Agni, son of strength, of lightning chariot, with flame as hair, has spread his might upon the earth.

sanskrit: ayā̍mi te̱ nama̍uktiṁ juṣasva̱ ṛtā̍va̱s tubhya̱ṁ ceta̍te sahasvaḥ | vi̱dvām̐ ā va̍kṣi vi̱duṣo̱ ni ṣa̍tsi̱ madhya̱ ā ba̱rhir ū̱taye̍ yajatra ||
english: I offer you this homage-speech; be pleased with it. O truthful, mighty one, it becomes visible to you. Knowing all, bring the knowing ones; sit in the midst of the sacred grass for our aid, O worthy of worship.

sanskrit: drava̍tāṁ ta u̱ṣasā̍ vā̱jaya̍ntī̱ agne̱ vāta̍sya pa̱thyā̍bhi̱r accha̍ | yat sī̍m a̱ñjanti̍ pū̱rvyaṁ ha̱virbhi̱r ā va̱ndhure̍va tasthatur duro̱ṇe ||
english: May the prize-winning Dawns run toward you, O Agni, along the paths of the wind. When they anoint you, the ancient one, with oblations, they two stand in the dwelling as at the chariot-pole.

sanskrit: mi̱traś ca̱ tubhya̱ṁ varu̍ṇaḥ saha̱svo 'gne̱ viśve̍ ma̱ruta̍ḥ su̱mnam a̍rcan | yac cho̱ciṣā̍ sahasas putra̱ tiṣṭhā̍ a̱bhi kṣi̱tīḥ pra̱thaya̱n sūryo̱ nṝn ||
english: Mitra and mighty Varuṇa and all the Maruts seek your favour, O Agni. When, O son of strength, you stand with your flame, extending your reach over settlements and men like the sun.

sanskrit: va̱yaṁ te̍ a̱dya ra̍ri̱mā hi kāma̍m uttā̱naha̍stā̱ nama̍sopa̱sadya̍ | yaji̍ṣṭhena̱ mana̍sā yakṣi de̱vān asre̍dhatā̱ manma̍nā̱ vipro̍ agne ||
english: Today we have given you what you desire, approaching you with upraised hands and reverence. With your most sacrificing mind worship the gods; O inspired Agni, do so with unfaltering thought.

sanskrit: tvad dhi pu̍tra sahaso̱ vi pū̱rvīr de̱vasya̱ yanty ū̱tayo̱ vi vājā̍ḥ | tvaṁ de̍hi saha̱sriṇa̍ṁ ra̱yiṁ no̍ 'dro̱gheṇa̱ vaca̍sā sa̱tyam a̍gne ||
english: From you, O son of strength, the many divine aids go forth and the prizes. O Agni, give us a thousandfold treasure with truthful, guileless speech.

sanskrit: tubhya̍ṁ dakṣa kavikrato̱ yānī̱mā deva̱ martā̍so adhva̱re aka̍rma | tvaṁ viśva̍sya su̱ratha̍sya bodhi̱ sarva̱ṁ tad a̍gne amṛta svade̱ha ||
english: O divine one of skill and poetic will, what these mortals have done at the sacrifice is for you. Be the protector of all who have a good chariot; O immortal Agni, let all this be sweet to you.

sanskrit: vi pāja̍sā pṛ̱thunā̱ śośu̍cāno̱ bādha̍sva dvi̱ṣo ra̱kṣaso̱ amī̍vāḥ | su̱śarma̍ṇo bṛha̱taḥ śarma̍ṇi syām a̱gner a̱haṁ su̱hava̍sya̱ praṇī̍tau ||
english: Blazing out with broad radiance, drive away enemies, Rākṣasas, and diseases. May I be in the great shelter of the well-sheltering one, under the guidance of Agni of easy invocation.

sanskrit: tvaṁ no̍ a̱syā u̱ṣaso̱ vyu̍ṣṭau̱ tvaṁ sūra̱ udi̍te bodhi go̱pāḥ | janme̍va̱ nitya̱ṁ tana̍yaṁ juṣasva̱ stoma̍m me agne ta̱nvā̍ sujāta ||
english: Be our protector at the breaking of this dawn, at the rising of the sun. Be pleased with my praise as with an ever-present offspring — O Agni well-born, be pleased with my body.

sanskrit: tvaṁ nṛ̱cakṣā̍ vṛṣa̱bhānu̍ pū̱rvīḥ kṛ̱ṣṇāsv a̍gne aru̱ṣo vi bhā̍hi | vaso̱ neṣi̍ ca̱ parṣi̱ cāty aṁha̍ḥ kṛ̱dhī no̍ rā̱ya u̱śijo̍ yaviṣṭha ||
english: You, the man-seeing bull, illuminate many dark nights, O ruddy Agni. O wealth, you lead us and carry us beyond affliction; O youngest one, make us desire wealth.

sanskrit: aṣā̍ḻho agne vṛṣa̱bho di̍dīhi̱ puro̱ viśvā̱ḥ saubha̍gā saṁjigī̱vān | ya̱jñasya̍ ne̱tā pra̍tha̱masya̍ pā̱yor jāta̍vedo bṛha̱taḥ su̍praṇīte ||
english: Blaze out, O invincible bull Agni, having conquered all the foremost good fortunes. O Jātavedas, guide and first guardian of the sacrifice, of great and excellent leadership.

sanskrit: acchi̍drā̱ śarma̍ jaritaḥ pu̱rūṇi̍ de̱vām̐ acchā̱ dīdyā̍naḥ sume̱dhāḥ ||
english: O singer, may you have many unbroken shelters. Blazing toward the gods, O wise one, carry our vigour forward like a prize-winning chariot; O Agni, set us in both worlds at ease.

sanskrit: pra pī̍paya vṛṣabha̱ jinva̱ vājā̱n agne̱ tvaṁ roda̍sī naḥ su̱doghe̍ | de̱vebhi̍r deva su̱rucā̍ rucā̱no mā no̱ marta̍sya durma̱tiḥ pari̍ ṣṭhāt ||
english: O bull, swell and enliven the prizes; O Agni, may you keep both our worlds yielding richly. O divine one, shining brilliantly with the gods — let not the evil thought of a mortal encompass us.

sanskrit: iḻā̍m agne puru̱daṁsa̍ṁ sa̱niṁ goḥ śa̍śvatta̱maṁ hava̍mānāya sādha | syān na̍ḥ sū̱nus tana̍yo vi̱jāvāgne̱ sā te̍ suma̱tir bhū̍tv a̱sme ||
english: O Agni, accomplish for the worshipper Iḷā of many wonders, the ever-abiding winning of the cow. May there be for us a son and offspring rich in descendants; O Agni, may that favour of yours be upon us.

sanskrit: a̱yam a̱gniḥ su̱vīrya̱syeśe̍ ma̱haḥ saubha̍gasya | rā̱ya ī̍śe svapa̱tyasya̱ goma̍ta̱ īśe̍ vṛtra̱hathā̍nām ||
english: This Agni rules over excellent heroic strength and great good fortune. He rules over wealth with good offspring; he rules over the slaying of the obstruction-demon, rich in cows.

sanskrit: i̱maṁ na̍ro marutaḥ saścatā̱ vṛdha̱ṁ yasmi̱n rāya̱ḥ śevṛ̍dhāsaḥ | a̱bhi ye santi̱ pṛta̍nāsu dū̱ḍhyo̍ vi̱śvāhā̱ śatru̍m āda̱bhuḥ ||
english: O Maruts, accompany this growing one, in whom the riches-swelling powers reside, those who are hard to overcome in battles, who have always seized the enemy.

sanskrit: sa tvaṁ no̍ rā̱yaḥ śi̍śīhi̱ mīḍhvo̍ agne su̱vīrya̍sya | tuvi̍dyumna̱ varṣi̍ṣṭhasya pra̱jāva̍to 'namī̱vasya̍ śu̱ṣmiṇa̍ḥ ||
english: O bountiful Agni, sharpen us for wealth and excellent heroic strength — O highly luminous one, of the highest, offspring-rich, disease-free, mighty wealth.

sanskrit: cakri̱r yo viśvā̱ bhuva̍nā̱bhi sā̍sa̱hiś cakri̍r de̱veṣv ā duva̍ḥ | ā de̱veṣu̱ yata̍ta̱ ā su̱vīrya̱ ā śaṁsa̍ u̱ta nṛ̱ṇām ||
english: He who has accomplished all, who has overcome all worlds, who has accomplished service among the gods — among the gods strive for, strive for excellent heroic strength, strive for the praise of men.

sanskrit: mā no̍ a̱gne 'ma̍taye̱ māvīra̍tāyai rīradhaḥ | māgotā̍yai sahasas putra̱ mā ni̱de 'pa̱ dveṣā̱ṁsy ā kṛ̍dhi ||
english: O Agni, do not surrender us to indigence, to lack of heroes, O son of strength; not to the grief-giver, not to reproach — avert the hatreds from us.

sanskrit: śa̱gdhi vāja̍sya subhaga pra̱jāva̱to 'gne̍ bṛha̱to a̍dhva̱re | saṁ rā̱yā bhūya̍sā sṛja mayo̱bhunā̱ tuvi̍dyumna̱ yaśa̍svatā ||
english: O blessed and highly luminous Agni, grant us strength of the prize at the great sacrifice, offspring-rich. Unite us with more abundant, bliss-bringing, and glorious wealth.
